summary:
新思科技最新季度財報營收大幅年增逾四成，每股盈餘優於市場預期，展現強勁成長動能。
• 季度營收達 2.48 億美元，年增率高達 42.37%。
• 每股盈餘 (EPS) 實際值 3.91 美元，優於市場預估的 3.67 美元。
• 核心半導體 IP 與 EDA 業務需求保持強勁，推動整體財務表現。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健，營收與獲利雙雙優於預期，顯示半導體設計工具需求依舊熱絡。短中期對股價偏向正面，但高本益比意味著對任何成長放緩的跡象高度敏感。後續應追蹤後續訂單能見度、AI 相關應用營收占比及總體經濟環境變化。

需留意：高達 69.80 的本益比顯示市場已預先計入高成長期望，若未來成長放緩可能引發估值修正。；宏觀經濟不確定性可能影響客戶的研發與 IT 支出預算。

summary_en:
Synopsys reported strong quarterly results with over 40% year-over-year revenue growth and an EPS beat.
• Quarterly revenue reached $2.48 billion, representing a 42.37% year-over-year increase.
• EPS of $3.91 beat the consensus estimate of $3.67.
• Core semiconductor IP and EDA businesses maintained robust demand, driving overall financial performance.

View: Solid earnings with top and bottom-line beats signal robust demand for semiconductor design tools. Near-to-mid-term stock implications are positive, though the high valuation makes it sensitive to any deceleration. Track order visibility, AI-related revenue contribution, and macroeconomic trends.

Watch：A trailing P/E of 69.80 indicates high growth expectations are already priced in, leaving little room for error.; Macroeconomic uncertainties could impact customer R&D and IT spending budgets.
